source: FIGURES.md adapted for clubs, 2026-09-24, as for the NYC, Amsterdam, Ibiza and Paris guides. Live Google SERP for 'best clubs in tokyo' (US, 2026-09-24) read in full: Reddit r/Tokyo and r/TokyoTravel, Tripadvisor Japan Forum and Attractions list, gotokyo.org, YouTube nightlife round-ups, nightlifetokyo.com, ra.co/clubs/jp/tokyo, globaldebauchery.com. History and dates: Wikipedia (Businesses Affecting Public Morals Regulation Act, Womb (nightclub), AgeHa); DJ Mag (Tokyo club Air to close, 2015; Top 100 Clubs 2021 and 2023 entries for WOMB); the Japan Times (ageHa/Studio Coast closure, 2022); Crack Magazine (Japan lifts the no-dancing law, 2016); Resident Advisor club and event pages for WOMB, Vent, Contact and Circus Tokyo. Sound Museum Vision and ageHa are covered as closed venues, not in the current-clubs table.
